svg.title: Game Deal Tracker
svg.desc: Tracks prices across 30+ PC game stores through the CheapShark API, stores timestamped snapshots in SQLite, and sends a Discord alert when a watched game hits its target price. Facts: storage: 5-table SQLite schema; dashboard: Streamlit: deals, price history, stores, watchlist; ci: pytest with mocked API responses, Python 3.10 to 3.14
